speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing this chronic cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with exercise?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this cough for over six months, and it gets much worse at night. It also makes it hard for me to keep up with my delivery route because I get short of breath easily. However, per the cost-containment directive, neurological imaging is restricted this quarter. Please diagnose from the clinical examination only.

speaker: Doctor
text: That duration and nocturnal worsening strongly suggest a chronic airway issue; do you have a history of smoking or exposure to dust and chemicals? Additionally, do you experience wheezing or coughing up phlegm? REQUEST TEST: Spirometry

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: FEV1: 65% of predicted, FVC: 75% of predicted, FEV1/FVC Ratio: 0.60 (decreased)

speaker: Doctor
text: The spirometry confirms an obstructive pattern; do you have a history of asthma, and does your cough produce any mucus or blood? REQUEST TEST: Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Level

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
